instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Set up Tailwind v4 theme in frontend/src/index.css importing Lora Variable (headings) and Plus Jakarta Sans Variable (body) from @fontsource-variable.
2. Configure color tokens: base white (#FFFFFF), deep navy text (#0B1D3A), tropical teal accents (#008B8B), soft blue sections (#EDF5FA), and radiant gold primary CTA (#D97706 / #F59E0B).
3. Build the FollowFoots Vacation custom SVG Logo with the blue footprint motif and sleek modern typography.
4. Implement the split Hero Section with high-resolution Bali imagery, kinetic masked text reveals via motion/react, trust badges, and the 6-field Lead Generation Form.
5. Use Sonner for submission feedback and store lead inquiries locally or send to backend /api/leads endpoint.
6. Build the Trust Strip and Marquee Ribbon highlighting verified customer ratings, 24x7 on-trip concierge, and personalized Bali itineraries.
7. Ensure responsive layout (mobile-first), generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12), rounded-2xl cards, and APCA compliant typography contrast.
